private_class_normalization: Only ABC namespace kind 5 is normalized to the short AS helper name. Per-script class multisets also compared, preserving helper ownership grouping. This is not a full private namespace identity proof.
scope: All original root SWFs and fresh FFDec export scripts/assets. Structural coverage and static frame binding only; no all-method or all-frame semantic equivalence claim.
